title: Episodic Memory Retrieval for Long-Horizon Autonomous Science Agents: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Autonomous research agents operating over multi-week research campaigns suffer from context window saturation and goal forgetting. We construct an episodic memory graph combining semantic vector clustering with hierarchical goal trees. The agent successfully completes 40-step scientific workflows with 89.2% task completion. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 2.2x and a verified task accuracy of 89.2% with mean execution latency of 6.4ms.
